test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 12th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends J, K, L, M, N, and P are sitting around a circular table facing the center. K is second to the left of J. P is opposite K. M is to the immediate right of L. J is between N and P. Who is sitting second to the right of M?
solution:
Given: Six friends J, K, L, M, N, and P are sitting around a circular table facing the center.

1) K is second to the left of J.

2) P is opposite K.

3) M is to the immediate right of L.
